high_level_description: The image appears to be a screenshot of an article from a website called "THE BYTE." The article discusses the mysterious super-fast beams detected by NASA's Voyager and New Horizons probes as they exit our Solar System. Scientists are unsure about the exact cause of these beams. The text mentions that the predominant theory, as noted by Mashable, is that these beams are caused by the explosion of stars known as supernovae. These explosions supercharge particles, sending them out into space in all directions.
